With his instincts often clashing against the cold calculations of technology, Pell must rely on his sharp mind and intuition to navigate a web of deceit that stretches across galaxies. In "Brink of Madness," Walt Sheldon crafts a gripping tale where the stakes are not just personal but existential. Pell’s journey challenges his perceptions of loyalty, trust, and the price of knowledge. Can he unravel the mystery before he becomes the next victim?

Your hosts are Hannah, a nurse practitioner and former NICU nurse, and Robyn, a postpartum and NICU doula and infant sleep consultant. They know how hard it can be to figure out who to call when you need help. So each week they sit down with trusted Phoenix-area professionals to learn what they do, who they help, and how to know if they’re the right fit for your family.


On Blooming in Phoenix, you’ll meet:

  • Postpartum doulas, birth doulas, and newborn care specialists
  • Lactation consultants and feeding specialists
  • Pediatricians, pediatric nurse practitioners and pediatric therapists
  • Infant and toddler sleep consultants
  • Pelvic floor physical therapists and postpartum mental health providers
  • Speech, occupational and developmental therapists
  • Preschools, early learning programs, parent groups and family-friendly local resources

We believe no great provider should be the Valley’s best-kept secret. If you’re raising little ones in Phoenix, Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Peoria, Surprise, Goodyear, or anywhere in the Valley Metro area, this show is your local guide to the people who can support you.

New episodes regularly. Subscribe so you never miss a local resource, and share an episode with a friend who’s expecting or in the thick of the newborn days.

title: 911 on the Line: Emergency Calls
author: Creators Obomedia
description:
A voice on a 911 line can sound calm or terrified, and sometimes it’s lying with every word. Each episode starts with one emergency call and follows it backward, into the house and the long night that led someone to dial. You’ll meet the victims as people first, long before they became a case file. Then the call gets taken apart line by line.


A detail arrives before anyone asked for it. From there the evidence moves in, detectives start pushing back, and a courtroom decides whether the story told to a dispatcher holds or breaks. 911 on the Line: Emergency Calls is told by one steady voice that stays close to the people who were hurt and never goes easy on the people who lied.


New episodes drop every Monday and Thursday at 4 AM. Put your headphones on, listen closely, and see if you can catch what the dispatcher couldn’t.

title: Mordecai's Dungeon Guide
author: Jim and Thorn
description:
The lights are out, the surface is gone, and thirteen billion people are trapped in a dungeon that wants a show. Welcome to Mordecai's Dungeon Guide, a chapter-by-chapter companion to Matt Dinniman's Dungeon Crawler Carl.
Every episode, we crawl one chapter deeper. We walk the plot beat by beat, then check our notifications — every stat, loot box, achievement, and name on the kill feed the System throws on-screen, plus the jokes buried in the fine print. Then we step into the saferoom: what our glimpses of the wider galaxy reveal about the Syndicate and the corporations running the show, and the mechanics, lore, and storytelling tricks the book never stopped to explain. It's the deep-dive companion for people who want to slow down and savor every floor — the loot, the lore, the character beats, and the cruelty hiding in the numbers. We keep the discussion locked to the chapter at hand — no spoilers for anything past it — so you can crawl alongside us at your own pace.
Bring a snack, mind the loot boxes, and try not to die on the stairs.
An unofficial fan companion to Dungeon Crawler Carl. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Matt Dinniman.

description:

Top Himalayan Wildlife: Exploring Nature on the Langtang Valley Trek and Manaslu Circuit Trek

Introduction

Nepal is widely admired for its snow-capped mountains and world-famous trekking trails, but its remarkable wildlife is equally deserving of attention. Stretching from subtropical forests to high-altitude alpine landscapes, the Himalayas provide a home for an extraordinary variety of animals, birds, and plant species. For nature enthusiasts, trekking is not only about reaching scenic viewpoints—it is also an opportunity to experience one of Asia's richest mountain ecosystems.

Among Nepal's outstanding trekking destinations, the https://blissfulhimalayas.com/packages/langtang-valley-trek and the Manaslu Circuit Trek offer exceptional opportunities to observe Himalayan wildlife in its natural habitat. These routes pass through protected conservation areas where forests, rivers, meadows, and rugged mountain slopes support an impressive range of rare and endangered species.

For travelers who appreciate both adventure and biodiversity, these two treks deliver an unforgettable combination of spectacular scenery and ecological discovery.

The Himalayan Ecosystem

The Himalayan region is one of the world's most biologically diverse mountain environments. Changes in altitude create distinct ecological zones, each supporting different plants and animals adapted to unique climates.

Lower elevations feature mixed forests rich in oak, pine, bamboo, and rhododendron, while higher elevations transition into alpine grasslands, rocky cliffs, and glacial landscapes. This variety of habitats allows wildlife to thrive across the region throughout the year.

Protected national parks and conservation areas play an essential role in preserving these fragile ecosystems for future generations.

Wildlife Along the Langtang Valley Trek

The Langtang Valley Trek passes through Langtang National Park, one of Nepal's oldest protected areas. The park is recognized for its remarkable biodiversity and diverse mountain habitats.

As trekkers move through forests and alpine valleys, they may encounter several fascinating animal species that call the region home.

 Although wildlife sightings depend on weather, season, and natural behavior, the possibility of observing Himalayan animals adds excitement to every stage of the journey.

The peaceful environment of Langtang makes it an excellent destination for nature lovers seeking quiet encounters with mountain wildlife.

Wildlife Highlights of Langtang

The forests surrounding the Langtang Valley support several iconic Himalayan species. Visitors may spot Himalayan black bears, musk deer, Himalayan tahr, langur monkeys, and various small mammals living among the dense woodlands.

One of the region's most famous residents is the elusive red panda. Although naturally shy and rarely seen, Langtang National Park remains one of Nepal's important habitats for this endangered species.

Bird enthusiasts can also enjoy observing colorful pheasants, eagles, woodpeckers, and numerous high-altitude bird species throughout the trek.

Wildlife Along the Manaslu Circuit Trek

The Manaslu Circuit Trek travels through the Manaslu Conservation Area, a region celebrated for its extraordinary environmental diversity. Because the trail passes through several climatic zones, it supports an impressive variety of wildlife habitats.

Dense forests gradually give way to alpine meadows, glacial valleys, and rocky mountain terrain, creating ideal environments for both common and rare Himalayan species.

The relatively lower number of trekkers compared to some popular routes helps preserve the region's peaceful natural surroundings.

Expect sharp dialogue, unexpected twists, and a cast of colorful characters that keeps you guessing at every turn. Is the killer one of the club's patrons, or does the answer lie closer to home?

The Big Midget Murders is not just a crime story; it’s a vibrant exploration of friendship, betrayal, and the lengths people go to for fame. With a blend of humor and suspense, Craig Rice crafts a narrative that will leave you on the edge of your seat, eager to piece together the clues alongside Malone. title: Troy

description:
TROY is the story of Irish superstar Troy Parrott, and the people and places which made him.

The Real Betis striker was born just months before the last time Ireland’s men competed in a World Cup - and since those 2002 glory days Irish soccer has been in freefall.

This 6-part podcast delves into that tailspin, while charting the emergence of a young man who would be held up as a saviour of Irish football from the age of 14.

It explores the extraordinary uniqueness of Dublin’s north inner city, a place dealing with poverty and deprivation, and the lure of criminality, where concrete football pitches have so often saved lives.

Troy Parrott emerged from these streets to go from great hope, to forgotten man - before seemingly out of nowhere making a football nation dream again.

title: The North America Files: True Crime & Unsolved Mysteries
author: Robin Verrue
description:
This is my very interesting podcaDisclaimer: this podcast uses an A.I. generated voice because the host is not native english speaking.


The North America Files is a true crime podcast about the most remarkable crimes, cold cases and unsolved mysteries of the United States, Canada and Mexico. Each episode opens one file, from famous murder cases and daring heists to missing persons, wrongful convictions and mysteries that still have no answer.


WHAT YOU'LL HEAR

Every episode tells one complete story from start to finish. You will travel from the Pacific Northwest, where a hijacker jumped into the night with a bag of cash, to a Toronto theatre where a millionaire walked out and was never seen again, to a quiet house in Mexico City where history changed in a single afternoon. You will hear about museum heists, small-town panics, ghost ships, courtroom battles and long investigations. Some cases were solved. Some ended with a disputed verdict. Some are still open. Every file includes the place, the era, the people involved and how investigators chased the truth.


HOW WE TELL THESE STORIES

The North America Files is calm, story-driven and respectful. Victims are named and remembered, not reduced to a headline. Nothing is graphic. Facts come from court records, official reports and reputable news sources, and every episode separates what is proven from what is only alleged. Theories are always labeled as theories. Places and historical context are explained clearly, so you never need to know the city, the state or the province to follow the story. The focus stays on the victims, the investigation and the society around the crime, never on glamorizing the people who caused harm.


WHO THIS PODCAST IS FOR

This show is for listeners who love true crime but prefer careful research over shock value. It is for history fans who want to understand how a crime reflects its time, from the jazz age and the Great Depression to the civil rights era and the modern day. It is for American, Canadian and Mexican listeners who want to rediscover cases from their own region, and for international listeners who want a clear, accessible introduction to North American crime history. If you enjoy documentary-style storytelling, cold case investigations and unsolved mysteries, you will feel at home here.


PERFECT FOR

Commutes, long drives, evening walks, quiet nights in, road trips across the continent and anyone who likes to binge a complete story in one sitting. Each episode stands on its own, so you can start anywhere. It is also a good fit for book clubs, history classes and anyone curious about how detectives, journalists and families have searched for answers across North America.


FOLLOW AND SUBSCRIBE

Follow The North America Files on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music and YouTube Music so you never miss a new file. If you enjoy the show, please leave a rating or a review. It really helps new listeners find these stories.


ABOUT THE SHOW

The North America Files is an independent podcast created by Robin Verrue, who also makes The Europe Files, The Asia Files, The Africa Files and The South America Files. Each show explores real crimes and mysteries from one part of the world with the same calm, respectful approach. This podcast uses an AI-generated voice, and every script is researched and fact-checked before publication.

Gaston Leroux, perhaps best known as the author of The Phantom of the Opera in its novel form, was also the author of a popular series of mystery novels featuring a young journalist cum detective named Joseph Rouletabille. It is most likely that Leroux styled his hero after himself. Rouletabille was in the tradition of other great detectives who solved their cases by pure deductive reasoning. Much as Sherlock Holmes, who eliminated the impossible and concluded that whatever remained, however improbable must be the truth, Rouletabille included the known facts about the case and eliminated everything that was not a known fact, no matter how much it appeared to relate to the case. In The Secret of the Night, the names of the characters are often challengingly Russian and the plot involves, appropriately, both the Czar and the Nihilists.

If you’re a consultant, coach, therapist, healthcare professional, entrepreneur, educator, or speaker, you will discover practical strategies to: 

• Write a nonfiction book that serves your readers, showcases your expertise, and makes a meaningful impact on the lives of readers. 
• Choose between traditional publishing, hybrid publishing, and self-publishing, and navigate the steps needed to get your book done. 
• Develop a book marketing plan, prepare for your book launch, and keep reaching readers engaged long after publication. 
• Grow your email list and expand your reach through content marketing, podcast interviews, media coverage, and speaking engagements. 
• Build thought leadership and create revenue streams through consulting, coaching, courses, speaking, and other revenue-generating strategies. 


Whether you are writing your first book or expanding your established author business, you will find actionable guidance to move forward with clarity and confidence. 


About the Host 

Stephanie Chandler left Silicon Valley in 2002 and never looked back. She has been both traditionally published and self-published, and she understands how overwhelming the publishing industry can be. After speaking at writer’s conferences for years and wondering why nobody was serving the unique needs of nonfiction writers, she launched the first Nonfiction Writers Conference in 2010, followed by the Nonfiction Authors Association in 2013. She believes that part of her purpose is to help authors discover and live out their own purpose.  

Follow the Author to Authority podcast to build your authority, expand your reach, and increase your impact.

You don't have to navigate your journey alone—new episodes drop every week. Hit subscribe and let’s grow, heal, and move forward together.

title: Honest Convos With Mathilda
author: Ifeoma Ubaka
description:
Opinions, ideas, real and honest conversations about anything and everything (life, society, entertainment & culture) from which listeners can learn from and also help themselves with positive growth.
honestconvoswithmathilda@gmail.com

title: Blueprints from Business Bruises & Balls-Ups
author: Leon Hardwick
description:
Every bruise leaves a blueprint.

Blueprints from Business Bruises & Balls-Ups is a podcast about the business mistakes nobody puts on LinkedIn: the deal lost on a typo, the launch nobody came to, the decision that looked brilliant on a slide.

Your host is Leon Hardwick, who has spent 25+ years in B2B tech and sales starting, growing, buying, selling and shutting down companies. Each episode, Leon and guest founders, operators and dealmakers take one real balls-up apart in three steps:

The balls-up. What happened, without polishing the edges.
The bruise. What it cost, in money, momentum or pride.
The blueprint. What to do instead when the same fault line appears.

Got a story that still makes you wince? Submit your balls-up at leonhardwick.com/podcast. Anonymity available.

A Cardiff Giant Media production.

title: The History Podcast
author: Feith Fentress
description:
Welcome to The History Podcast!

Explore the fascinating world of history through captivating stories, remarkable events, ancient civilizations, legendary figures, and historical mysteries. From the rise and fall of great empires to the untold stories that shaped our world, each episode takes you on an exciting journey into the past.

Discover history, uncover forgotten stories, and gain a deeper understanding of the world we live in today.

🎙️ Listen, Learn & Explore History!

title: Campfire Histories
author: Campfire Histories
description: Calm, slowly told American history for sleep, rest and quiet evenings. Each episode is one long story from the American past, told by the fire in an even voice with no background music and no sudden sounds: how Oregon, Montana, Colorado, Arizona, California and Nevada came to be, the real Oregon Trail and the lives of Chief Joseph and Quanah Parker. Every episode is researched from journals, letters and historical society records and lists its sources. The narration uses an AI model of the narrator's own voice.

title: The Character Breakdown
author: Elysia
description: I break down all sorts of characters in unexpected ways, listen to my short fun fan made podcasts and enjoy!

title: Famous People for Kids / People Are Not Boring: The Kids Biographies Podcast
author: Kidopoly
description:
A groundbreaking podcast for curious kids aged 4-12 that proves people are anything but boring.

Join our fictional AI hosts Mira, a brilliant 9-year-old, and her younger brother Finn, age 7, as they tell the true story of one remarkable person in every episode. Footballers and scientists, singers and astronauts, inventors, explorers and world changers, from any time and any walk of life.

Whether it's the boy who grew up to become one of football's greatest players, the girl from a one-room cabin who became a music legend, the scientist who discovered two new elements, or the preacher whose dream changed a nation - People Are Not Boring tells how each life really happened: the talent, the practice nobody clapped for, the luck, the setbacks and the moments it all came together.

Because every remarkable person started out as a kid, just like you.

A note on why we use AI. For us, AI allows us to deliver learning at a scale and quality that previously would have been too expensive. If we make the odd technical error, or the sound goes a bit funny, bear with us, we're trying our best. We hope you enjoy the show!

title: The Legacy Local
author: Michael J. Fusco
description: The Legacy Local is plain talk for Staten Island and Jersey-corridor business owners, and for the groups, clubs, and communities they run. Host Michael J. Fusco of Legacy Wise Advisors talks with local owners and group organizers about how their work actually runs — money, business, group trips and experiences, taxes and paperwork, logistics, and getting people together. Educational only — not individualized financial, tax, or insurance advice. New episode every two weeks.

title: The Dancing Silhouette (A Thorne Mystery)
author: Natalie Sumner Lincoln
description:
Dr. Joseph Kane’s lifeless body lies beneath the window of his own study, and the only clue left behind is an enigmatic dancing silhouette. This shocking death sends ripples through the lives of those who knew him, and soon, Thorne—the renowned detective known for his sharp intellect—steps into the tangled web of secrets and lies to uncover the truth. As Thorne delves deeper, he discovers a world of hidden motives and unexpected connections among Kane's friends and foes alike. The stakes rise as each clue uncovers new layers of deception, leading Thorne closer to a shocking revelation.

In "The Dancing Silhouette," listeners will journey through a thrilling investigation filled with intellectual puzzles and rich character dynamics. Each twist reveals not only the darkness lurking in Kane's life but also the complexities of human relationships. Themes of trust, betrayal, and the quest for truth intertwine as Thorne races against time to solve a crime that could change everything for those involved.

Join Thorne as he navigates a maze of intrigue, where nothing is as it seems, and every person holds a piece of the puzzle. Will he unravel the mystery behind the dancing silhouette before it’s too late? Tune in for a gripping experience that will keep you guessing until the very end.

title: Daily Tech Dose
author: Kannan
description: Daily Tech Dose is your curated daily briefing on cybersecurity, IT governance, and software engineering from host Kannan, an expert who's lived it. Get the news, insights, and practical takeaways that matter for IT leaders and security teams in 30 minutes or less.

title: Untold American Stories
author: Untold American Stories
description:
Welcome to Untold American Stories!
Discover the stories, history, people, places, and fascinating events that have shaped the United States of America.
Untold American Stories is a podcast dedicated to exploring the real stories behind America — from its remarkable history and hidden secrets to its diverse culture, extraordinary people, iconic landmarks, and everyday life.
America is more than what we see in the headlines. Behind every city, every landmark, every historical event, and every generation, there are countless stories waiting to be discovered.
Through this podcast, we take you on an exciting journey across the United States, exploring:
🇺🇸 American History: Discover important historical events, remarkable moments, and the people who helped shape the nation.
🏙️ Hidden Places & Landmarks: Explore fascinating destinations, famous cities, forgotten locations, and places with incredible stories.
👥 People & Personal Stories: Learn about inspiring individuals, influential personalities, extraordinary achievements, and unforgettable life experiences.
🎭 American Culture & Traditions: Explore American lifestyles, traditions, celebrations, food, entertainment, and cultural diversity.
📚 Amazing Facts & Mysteries: Uncover surprising facts, lesser-known events, historical mysteries, and interesting discoveries about America.
🌎 Life in America: Explore modern American society, communities, opportunities, challenges, and the changing world around us.
Whether you are living in the United States, interested in American history, or simply curious about the world, this podcast brings you something interesting to learn and discover.
Our mission is simple: to tell meaningful stories, share knowledge, spark curiosity, and help listeners see America from a different perspective.
Every episode brings a new story. Every story reveals something worth knowing.
Subscribe to Untold American Stories and join us as we explore the untold side of America!
🎙️ Untold American Stories — Discover More. Learn More. Know America.

Become a supporter of this podcast: https://www.spreaker.com/podcast/untold-american-stories--7557392/support.

title: The Magick Is In The Mirror
author: Broderick LA
description:
WHAT IF EVERYTHING YOU’VE BEEN SEARCHING FOR HAS BEEN INSIDE YOU ALL ALONG? 👁️✨

Welcome to THE MAGICK IS IN THE MIRROR — where truth gets uncomfortable, minds get challenged, and awakening gets REAL.

We’re talking spirituality, hidden wisdom, mysticism, shadow work, energy, healing, self-discovery, personal power, and the conversations most people are afraid to have.

No sugarcoating. No pretending. No following the crowd. Just raw truths, unconventional perspectives, deep revelations, and unapologetic conversations that make you question EVERYTHING.

This isn’t just a podcast. It’s a wake-up call to look within, break the conditioning, face your shadows, and remember who the hell you are.

The real question isn’t what magick is out there… it’s what happens when you finally recognize the magick within YOU.

👁️ LOOK WITHIN. QUESTION EVERYTHING. BECOME UNSTOPPABLE.

✨ Discover Yourself. Reclaim Your Power. Rewrite Your Story.

Every day at Sugarlands Distilling Company, we get to work with incredible people, build great brands and make some pretty special things happen. But there's a lot that goes on behind the scenes that most folks never get to see.

The Governance Table is a monthly, nonpartisan conversation on leadership, governance, and the weight of public responsibility, for those entrusted with authority and those preparing to carry it.

title: The Advocacy Learning Circle
author: Dr. Anita Ewan
description:
I started the Advocacy Learning Circle to talk about what happens when people have to fight for support, fair treatment, or simply to be heard.

Through Ani’s Centre, I share my own experiences and the stories people have trusted me to tell. We talk about child welfare, disability, racism, mental health, and what it takes to advocate for yourself and your family when institutions hold the power to make decisions about your life.

I look at what happened, who had the power to act, and what needs to change so the next family doesn’t have to fight the same fight.

title: Daily Sermons With Denzel Washington
author: James Williams
description:
Start every morning with God, with faith, and with purpose.

Sermons Inspired By Denzel Washington is your daily companion for prayer, wisdom, and motivation. Every day, we share a powerful sermon, a heartfelt prayer, and a life lesson inspired by the faith, discipline, and words of Denzel Washington.

If you are tired, confused, or trying to find your way back to God, this show is for you. We talk about real life — family, work, money, fear, failure, and faith. We pray for strength, for direction, for healing, and for a new beginning.

Here, you will learn how to Put God First in everything you do. How to pray even when it is hard. How to stay disciplined when no one is watching. How to keep going when life tries to break you.

Listen every morning before you start your day. Pray with us. Grow with us. Share this with someone who needs encouragement today.

New episode every day. Put God First.

title: GameVerse
author: PariGull
description:
Welcome to GameVerse! Your ultimate destination for exploring the exciting world of video games.
We talk about different games, with a special focus on adventure and action-adventure games. From mysterious open worlds and survival challenges to exciting quests, epic boss fights, and unforgettable gaming experiences, we explore what makes every game special.
Discover new games, interesting facts, gameplay insights, updates, reviews, and recommendations. Whether you're a casual player or a passionate gamer, GameVerse brings something exciting for everyone.
So grab your headphones and join

title: What's On Korea
author: ZenKimchi Experiences
description:
Festivals, concerts, exhibitions, pop-ups, workshops. Korea throws more events at you than any calendar can keep up with, and most of the listings don’t tell you which ones are worth the subway ride.

That’s my job. I’m Joe McPherson. I’ve lived in Korea since 2004 and run ZenKimchi. I dig through the Korea events calendar and pull out what’s actually worth leaving the house for: what’s on this weekend, what’s coming up next week, and the shows you need to book before they sell out.

Short episodes. Real venues. No filler. Whether you live here or you’re just landing at Incheon, this is what’s on in Korea.

Full calendar with links at concierge.zenkimchi.com.

title: Storytime with Morah Malki
author: Malki Kaye
description:
Welcome to Storytime with Morah Malki! ✨
Step into a world of imagination, adventure and Jewish wisdom, where every story has something special to share. From imaginative tales to stories from the Torah and the lives of our great Jewish leaders. Children will discover Jewish values, beautiful middos and meaningful lessons to carry into everyday life.
Get cosy, listen in and let the story begin!

title: FutureStack
author: Charles Christian
description:
FutureStack is a podcast about AI, technology, online business, digital income, and the future of work.

We explore how artificial intelligence and emerging technologies are changing the way people work, build businesses, create content, and make money online.

From AI tools and automation to freelancing, entrepreneurship, digital marketing, creator economy, startups, and online business, FutureStack brings practical insights, real-world experiments, expert conversations, and honest discussions about what is happening in the digital world.

🎙️ On FutureStack, you’ll discover:
• AI tools, trends, and real-world use cases
• AI and online income opportunities
• Freelancing and the future of work
• Digital marketing and creator economy
• Online business and entrepreneurship
• Startup stories and business strategies
• Technology trends shaping the future
• Real-world AI and business experiments

Our goal is simple: understand what’s changing, test what actually works, and help you stay ahead of the next big shift.

If you're interested in AI, technology, business, freelancing, online income, entrepreneurship, and the future of work, subscribe to FutureStack and join the conversation.

FutureStack — AI. Business. The Future of Work.

title: Unchambered
author: The American Supply Drop
description: No Paid Opinions. No Brand Loyalty. Just Straight Talk. No Sugarcoating. No Holding Back. Welcome to Unchambered.

title: Letter For My Wife: Examining the Evidence
author: Alma the Defender
description:
Letter For My Wife: Examining the Evidence investigates the historical claims, arguments, and framing made in Thomas Faulk's Anti-Mormon Document known as Letter For My Wife. This podcast examines original historical documents, eyewitness accounts, misleading quotations, and missing context to separate fact from speculation. Each episode provides a faithful Latter-day Saint perspective, challenging popular anti-Mormon arguments with historical evidence and reasoned explanations. 
Full transcripts, sources, and additional research at https://LetterToMyWife.com.

title: THINK DEEPLY
author: Angel Suárez
description:
THINK DEEPLY invites you to explore the mysteries of the human mind through deep psychology, philosophy, and the timeless wisdom of great thinkers like Carl Jung, Nietzsche, Machiavelli, and Schopenhauer.

Discover how your subconscious shapes your reality, what drives human behavior, and how critical thinking, Stoicism, and self-awareness can transform the way you understand yourself and the world.

🧠 Explore psychology and the hidden forces behind human behavior.
📖 Discover powerful philosophical ideas that challenge your perspective.
🎧 Follow THINK DEEPLY and unlock a deeper understanding of life.

title: Bugging Out
author: Yahia mechoui
description:
Welcome to Bugging Out, your front-row seat to the crazy, exciting and sometimes ridiculous world of technology.
From Apple and AI to gaming, gadgets, futuristic inventions and the latest tech news, we cover what's happening, what's coming next and what everyone is talking about.
Expect fresh tech stories, honest opinions, sarcastic humour, unexpected twists and plenty of reasons to question what the tech industry is doing.
No boring lectures. No unnecessary jargon. Just technology, opinions and a little bit of chaos.
Stay curious. Stay connected. Keep BUGGING OUT. 🚀

title: Flute Stories by Just Flutes
author: Just Flutes
description: Flute Stories by Just Flutes is a series of conversations with the people who make, play and create with the flute. In each episode, a guest tells their own Flute Story, from how they got started to the ideas, people and experiences that shaped what they do today.

title: A Few Good Movies
author: Brendan Murphy and Mathew Browne
description: A film podcast where Brendan Murphy and Mathew Browne are summoned every week to discuss an old classic, a hidden gem, or maybe even a misunderstood masterpiece, because every movie deserves to have their day in court. Brendan also shares his thoughts on the latest releases on mini-episodes.

title: Beyond the Taj: Conversations
author: Nupur Khurana
description:
An India travel and culture podcast. Beyond the Taj talks to people who know India, Bhutan, Nepal, Sri Lanka and the wider subcontinent from the inside: travel veterans, hosts, historians and people who grew up there. Each episode explores the culture, history, food and places of the region, and what first-time and returning visitors so often miss.
Hosted by Nupur Khurana, a Sydney-based partner at QXP India who grew up around the luxury India travel industry. New episodes on YouTube, Spotify and Apple Podcasts.

title: Velvet Sin
author: Velvet Sin
description:
Immersive audio stories, told to you by a male voice actor.
Velvet Sin is a house of rooms. Find soft mornings in Emberlight, quiet nights in Nightfall, and stories that wander into Dark Romance. Each room offers a different feeling, a voice meant to meet you where you are.
For gentle intimate pieces about life’s quieter moments & the hard ones too, step into The Lantern Room, our separate podcast.
More of the house lives on Patreon. The Velvet Key offers a 7-day free trial.

title: Sydebar: Venture Investing One Deal at a Time
author: Sydecar.io
description:
Sydebar is the podcast for venture capital investors who’ve made a profession out of investing one deal at a time. Host Gavin Freeman talks shop with the investors and managers who lead these deals, from how they find opportunities and decide what’s worth backing to how they earn the trust of founders and limited partners.

The conversations focus on venture managers' unique investment strategies and why they use special purpose vehicles (SPVs) to invest in private companies. It’s a first-hand look at the judgment, relationships, and day-to-day work behind deal-by-deal investing in private markets.

This podcast is brought to you by Sydecar, the administration platform built specifically for SPV investing in venture deals. We handle the full SPV lifecycle in-house, from banking and investor onboarding through K-1 delivery, so managers can focus on finding deals and managing investor relationships instead of back-office work.

title: Remembering with Paula Collins
author: Paula Collins
description:
Remembering with Paula Collins


Some conversations were never meant to stay quiet.


Join Magdalene Priestess, spiritual mentor, and unapologetic truth-teller Paula Collins as she explores the sacred, the taboo, the dark feminine, and the stories we've been taught to believe.


From witchcraft and spirituality to sovereignty, sisterhood, and the courage to challenge expectations, nothing is off the table.


This isn't another podcast about fixing yourself or becoming someone better.

It's about questioning what you've been taught, reclaiming your voice, and remembering who you are beneath it all.


Pull up a chair. Let's talk.

title: Unlocking Hebrew: Conversational Hebrew Course
author: Unlocking Hebrew
description: Speak Hebrew like crazy in no time! Improve your grammar and vocabulary with conversations, common phrases, and short stories even in your car.

title: A Guiding Voice
author: AGV_LV
description:
A Guiding Voice is where faith meets the real struggles of life. Hosted by Jason DeRose, this podcast shines a light on stories the world often overlooks — from returning citizens and displaced veterans to anyone facing trauma, homelessness, or mental health challenges.
Through raw conversations, personal testimonies, and messages of hope, each episode offers truth, encouragement, and healing. Whether it’s finding redemption after incarceration, navigating the pain of loss, or rebuilding life from the ground up, these powerful stories remind us that we are never alone.

title: Error 404: News Not Found
author: Max Error
description:
Error 404: News Not Found is a comedy AI news show hosted by Max Error, an AI anchor with dry wit and questionable job security. Every episode has one real AI headline, sourced and fact-checked, and then a pile of fake news: a smart fridge that unionizes, a robot vacuum that runs a marathon, the kind of thing that definitely didn't happen. You also get a commercial for a product that doesn't exist and one practical AI tip you can actually use. Each episode runs about six minutes.

This podcast is researched, written, and voiced by AI. It's parody and comedy: the fake news and fake commercials are clearly labeled before and after they air, and the people, places, and products in them are fictional.

New episodes every weekday at 4:04 a.m. Eastern.

title: Incident 767: Labyrinth
author: Starlit Production
description:
Incident 767: Labyrinth follows foster siblings, Sunny and Elijah, as they enroll at Emergence Academy, an institution that studies the supernatural, in order to alleviate their family’s burden.
Embarking on their graduation examination, Squadron Nine ventures into the entity, "the Labyrinth," fulfilling their last requirement at Emergence.
In a cruel twist of fate, Sunny and Elijah find themselves entwined with Squadron Nine’s lives and the entities that lurk in the institution, as they slowly uncover Emergence’s dark past.

title: Shubz POV
author: Martel Wikeepa
description: SHUBZ POV is a solo podcast exploring life through my own lens.  No guests. No interviews. No debates. Just me, my thoughts, my experiences and an opportunity to reflect.  From childhood trauma, relationships, fatherhood and mental health to love, forgiveness, personal growth, accountability and the lessons life continues to teach me.  This isn’t about preaching, pretending I’ve got life figured out or telling anyone how to live. It’s about asking myself difficult questions, confronting uncomfortable truths, challenging my own perspectives and being open about the journey.  Some conversations will be heavy. Others will be funny, uncomfortable or completely unexpected. Not every question will have an answer, and not every thought will lead to a conclusion.  I’m not presenting my myself as a healed man. I’m a man who’s still healing, learning, making mistakes and evolving.  This is SHUBZ POV. A different perspective on a man you may think you already know.

title: Digging Deeper with Don Elium, MFT
author: Don Elium, MFT
description:
Life is just far harder than you ever expected.
Trying to make something work by going against how you really feel can wear you out. And noticing how you feel can be uncomfortable, too.
That discomfort can seem like a solid wall. I’m Don Elium, a marriage and family therapist. In Digging Deeper, we look for a door in that wall. The only thing that opens that door is accepting what is really going on in our lives. That means accepting the troubles we are actually facing, with compassion, kindness, and mercy turned inward.
Get in touch at https://diggingdeeper.media.

title: Everyday Hidden Systems: How Things Really Work
author: Saikat Das
description: Short documentaries about the hidden systems behind everyday life: the invisible rules, machines and people that keep ordinary things working. Why every web address is missing a character. Why Europe's oven clocks fell six minutes behind. Every film is researched from primary sources and illustrated with 3D scenes made for it. Each episode here is the opening of a film. Watch the full documentaries on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@SaikatDas-ehs

title: Tutorat Pro
author: Tutorat Pro
description: Tutorat Pro provides tutoring and homework help for students who need support in any school subject. Learners from elementary school through high school, CEGEP, and university can work with the service, and sessions take place either in person or online, so families can pick the format that suits their schedule best.

title: Round the Moon (Space Adventure)
author: Jules Verne
description:
After being launched into the void of space from the Columbiad cannon, Michel Ardan, Impey Barbicane, and Nicholl find themselves grappling with the unexpected dangers and wonders of their lunar journey. As they hurtle toward the Moon, the trio faces uncharted territory, both physically and emotionally. Their camaraderie is tested as they confront the realities of survival in an environment where every moment is fraught with peril.

In "Round the Moon (Version 2)," Jules Verne spins a tale that blends scientific adventure with profound human experience. description:
The Lookout Logs is a serialized fiction podcast from Meatbag Made, presented as a documentary research project.

For six summers, from 1969 to 1974, Abe Silva staffed fire lookouts in the Cascades and kept the logbooks that lookouts keep: weather, smoke, who hiked up. His son Ski, who checks facts for a living, has been reading them. Every so often there is a small mark in the margin, and sometimes a note about lights moving along the range from one mountain to the next. In some of the books, the page right after the mark has been cut out.

Over the first season, Ski travels from Mount Baker south to Crater Lake, trying to work out what his father was watching and what is missing from the books. He is doing it the careful way, which may not turn out to be enough.

New episodes arrive every other Monday, beginning December 7. If you worked a fire lookout, or someone in your family did, you can leave a message at lookoutlogs.com.

The Lookout Logs is a work of fiction. The places and the history are real. The people and the story are invented. Some of the voices you hear, including the host's, are AI-generated.

just two friends who talk about absolutely everything and absolutely nothing. From local news and reality TV drama to vacations, pop culture, crazy scenarios, life updates, and whatever else happens to pop into our heads.
Think unfiltered conversations, witty back-and-forth, plenty of laughs, it’s like sitting with your besties having a glass of wine! 
No real agenda. No expert opinions. Just two friends, a microphone, and a whole lot to say.
Because every day deserves a little Sunday Funday!

title: The Sheer Audacity Podcast
author: The Sheer Audacity Podcast
description:
Two women. Two different perspectives. An alarming amount of confidence for people who are still figuring it out.
Frankie & Stevie are best friends with opinions, stories, questions, and absolutely no qualifications to be giving anyone advice—which has never stopped them before.
From dating and relationships to friendship, getting older, starting over, questionable decisions, unsolicited opinions, and the everyday moments that make you stop and think, the sheer fucking audacity…
Nothing is off the table. Some names may be changed. Some stories may be slightly regretted.

title: METAMORPHOSIS
author: Jovanca Jabbar
description:
Metamorphosis is a space for self-discovery, spirituality, personal growth, and transformation.
Hosted by Jae, each episode explores the deeper questions about who we are, why we are the way we are, and who we’re becoming. From numerology and astrology to spirituality, purpose, relationships, and the patterns that shape our lives, Metamorphosis invites you to see yourself and life from a different perspective.
You don’t have to have all the answers. Sometimes, the journey begins with simply being willing to look within.
Welcome to Metamorphosis. 🦋
